fields.questionText: The rod of a TV disc antenna is fixed at right angles to a vertical wall AB, and a rod CD supports the disc. This forms a triangle ACD, right-angled at A, in which AC = 1.5 m, the supporting rod CD = 3 m is the hypotenuse, and θ is the acute angle ∠ADC between CD and AD. Compute the value of sec θ + cosec θ.
solutionSteps: [1 mark] By Pythagoras, AD = √(CD² − AC²) = √(9 − 2.25) = √6.75 = (3√3)/2 m. So sec θ = CD/AD = 3 ÷ (3√3/2) = 2/√3 and cosec θ = CD/AC = 3/1.5 = 2.

fields.questionText: Prove that: sin⁶θ + cos⁶θ = 1 − 3 sin²θ cos²θ.
fields.answer: LHS = (sin²θ + cos²θ)³ − 3 sin²θ cos²θ (sin²θ + cos²θ) = 1 − 3 sin²θ cos²θ = RHS

[1 mark] = 1 × [(sin²θ + cos²θ)² − 2 sin²θ cos²θ − sin²θ cos²θ], using sin²θ + cos²θ = 1.

fields.questionText: Prove that (sin A + cos A)/(sin A − cos A) + (sin A − cos A)/(sin A + cos A) = 2/(2 sin²A − 1).
fields.answer: LHS = [(sin A + cos A)² + (sin A − cos A)²]/(sin²A − cos²A) = 2/(2 sin²A − 1) = RHS
solutionSteps: [1 mark] LHS = [(sin A + cos A)² + (sin A − cos A)²] / [(sin A − cos A)(sin A + cos A)].
[1 mark] Numerator = (1 + 2 sin A cos A) + (1 − 2 sin A cos A) = 2; denominator = sin²A − cos²A.
[1 mark] sin²A − cos²A = sin²A − (1 − sin²A) = 2 sin²A − 1, so LHS = 2/(2 sin²A − 1) = RHS. Hence proved.
fields.finalAnswer: (sin A + cos A)/(sin A − cos A) + (sin A − cos A)/(sin A + cos A) = 2/(2 sin²A − 1) (proved)

fields.questionText: A kite is flying at a height of 60 m above the ground level. Ravi, standing on the roof of a house, is holding the string straight and observes the angle of elevation of the kite as 30°. From the bottom of the same building, the angle of elevation of the kite is 45°. Find the length of the string and the height of the roof from the ground. (Use √3 = 1.73)
fields.answer: Length of the string = 40√3 m ≈ 69.2 m; height of the roof = (60 − 20√3) m ≈ 25.4 m
solutionSteps: [1 mark] Let K be the kite, KG = 60 m its height above the ground, T the bottom and R the top (roof) of the building; S is the point on KG level with the roof, so SR = GT and KS = 60 − TR.
[1 mark] From T: tan 45° = KG/GT ⇒ 1 = 60/GT ⇒ GT = 60 m, so SR = 60 m.
[1 mark] From R: tan 30° = KS/SR ⇒ 1/√3 = KS/60 ⇒ KS = 20√3 m ≈ 34.6 m.
[1 mark] Height of roof TR = 60 − 20√3 = 60 − 34.6 = 25.4 m.
[1 mark] sin 30° = KS/KR ⇒ 1/2 = 20√3/KR ⇒ KR = 40√3 = 69.2 m. Length of string = 69.2 m; height of roof = 25.4 m.
fields.finalAnswer: Length of the string = 69.2 m; height of the roof from the ground = 25.4 m
